lines.reference: SA cake wheat flour label (Golden Cloud, via FatSecret ZA): 1499 kJ, 8.2 g protein, 0.9 g fat, 76 g glycaemic carbohydrate / 100 g (used 358 kcal / 100 g)
Oil, sunflower, linoleic (less than 60%) — USDA FDC 171017: 884 kcal / 100 g
Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Half Butter, salted (USDA FDC 173410), half Oil, sunflower (USDA FDC 171017), by weight: 800 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: dusting flour not counted; all 100 g of layering butter and the 3 tbsp butter-and-oil brushing mix end up in the roti. Sanity check: Woolworths butter roti is 271 kcal per 75 g (361 kcal / 100 g, FatSecret ZA) and USDA paratha (FDC 174076) is 326 kcal / 100 g. Ours is ~353 kcal / 100 g (3002 kcal over ~850 g cooked), ~106 g and 375 kcal each.
